usageNotes: Removes the custom TLS certificate and private key from the specified node, reverting pveproxy to its self-signed certificate. Use `restart: true` to immediately reload pveproxy so the change takes effect without a manual service restart; omitting it means the old certificate stays in memory until the next pveproxy restart. Requires `Sys.Modify` on `/nodes/{node}` — API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Remove the custom certificate on node pve1 and restart pveproxy immediately

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the node's custom certificate chain and private key; HTTPS access reverts to the self-signed certificate, which will trigger browser/client trust warnings until a new certificate is uploaded.
tips: If `restart` is false (default), pveproxy continues serving the old certificate from memory until the service is manually restarted or the node reboots.
After deletion, upload a replacement certificate with the POST /nodes/{node}/certificates/custom endpoint before restarting pveproxy to avoid a trust gap.
Returns null on success — no UPID is issued; the operation is synchronous.
